title: AI-Powered Exam Preparation & Assessment Platform (Full-Stack Distributed SaaS Architecture)
description: Architected an AI-powered examination & assessment platform using Next.js 15, React 18, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase Auth, Stripe, and Docker.
Designed a layered system architecture with SSR/CSR rendering, REST APIs, secure internal service communication, and containerized deployment via Docker Compose.
Built a modular frontend with Next.js App Router, protected routes, reusable components, and a hybrid exam engine combining React with vanilla JavaScript modules.
Implemented Firebase Auth + Admin SDK authentication with JWT verification middleware and RBAC-based access control (free, premium, admin roles).
Developed Stripe-based billing system with subscriptions, recurring payments, webhook processing, renewals, cancellations, promo codes, and payment reconciliation.
Built LLM-based AI scoring pipeline for writing/speaking tasks using structured prompts, JSON outputs, rubric-based evaluation, and stored feedback analytics.
Designed normalized PostgreSQL schema for users, content taxonomy, exams, AI scores, payments, audit logs, login history, and system configuration.
Implemented secure asset streaming via tokenized endpoints and backend validation for protected exam media delivery.
Built admin system for user management, content sync, taxonomy editing, promo codes, email templates, analytics, audit logs, and monitoring tools.
Added production security: Helmet.js headers, CORS policies, rate limiting, webhook signature verification, and centralized error logging.
Integrated external services (Stripe, Firebase, SMTP, LLM APIs) with resilient, fault-tolerant workflows and structured observability.
Containerized full stack using Docker with isolated services, environment configs, and production-ready deployment orchestration.

title: Fuzzy Control of Truck-Trailer Auto Parking in the Presence of Obstacles
description: Developed a hierarchical fuzzy logic controller in MATLAB/Simulink for autonomous reverse parking of a truck-trailer system.
Modeled the nonlinear kinematics of a 4-DOF trailer-truck vehicle and implemented steering control algorithms for reverse maneuvering.
Designed Mamdani and Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy inference systems to generate adaptive steering commands based on vehicle orientation and parking position.
Implemented an 8-direction fuzzy decision-making framework for trajectory planning and parking path correction during autonomous parking operations.
Integrated obstacle avoidance functionality using distance- and angle-based fuzzy rules to enable collision-free parking in constrained environments.
Developed fuzzy compensation mechanisms to regulate the articulation angle between the truck and trailer, improving maneuverability and stability.
Simulated multiple parking scenarios with varying initial conditions and obstacle configurations to evaluate controller performance and robustness.
Validated autonomous parking accuracy through trajectory analysis, demonstrating stable path tracking and successful parking completion.

title: Design and Programming of a 3-DoF Robot Controller Circuit Board
description: Designed and developed an embedded control system for a 3-DoF robotic manipulator using an ATmega32 AVR microcontroller.
Implemented simultaneous position and motion control of two servo motors and one DC motor to execute predefined robotic trajectories.
Programmed the controller in Embedded C to process user commands and generate real-time motor control signals.
Integrated keypad and LCD interfaces for user input, motion parameter configuration, and system status monitoring.
Designed motor driver circuitry using H-bridge drivers and supporting electronics for reliable actuator control.
Developed complete schematic diagrams and multi-layer PCB layouts, including power regulation, signal routing, and peripheral interfaces.
Performed circuit simulation and functional verification using Proteus prior to hardware implementation.
Fabricated, assembled, and tested the custom controller board, validating coordinated robotic motion and system functionality.

title: Control System Design of a Nonlinear Inverted Pendulum System
description: Developed a mathematical model of a nonlinear inverted pendulum-on-cart system using Newtonian dynamics and derived governing equations of motion.
Linearized the nonlinear system around the upright equilibrium point and formulated both transfer function and state-space representations.
Implemented system modeling and simulation in MATLAB, including transfer function generation, state-space analysis, and dynamic response visualization.
Performed stability analysis using pole-zero maps, root locus techniques, impulse responses, and step response evaluations.
Investigated open-loop system behavior and identified inherent instability characteristics of the inverted pendulum system.
Designed and tuned classical feedback controllers using root-locus-based compensation techniques to stabilize the system.
Implemented state-space control approaches including pole placement and Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) methods for optimal stabilization.
Developed state observer models for estimating unmeasured states and improving control system performance.
Validated controller effectiveness through simulation of both linearized and nonlinear system models under various operating conditions.

title: Hydraulic Circuit Design for Ring Rolling Machine
description: Designed hydraulic circuits for a ring rolling machine based on specified force, stroke, pressure, and speed requirements.
Performed hydraulic actuator sizing calculations, including cylinder bore and piston rod diameter selection for multiple machine functions.
Conducted piston rod buckling analysis and mechanical verification to ensure safe operation under design loads.
Calculated actuator flow-rate requirements and operating velocities to support hydraulic system design.
Selected hydraulic components including cylinders, flow-control valves, directional-control valves, filters, relief valves, and pumps using manufacturer catalogs.
Analyzed pressure losses throughout the hydraulic system and determined appropriate relief valve settings for safe operation.
Developed detailed hydraulic and electro-hydraulic schematics integrating actuators, valves, pumps, and auxiliary components.
Designed common hydraulic subsystems including reservoir sizing, piping selection, hydraulic oil selection, cooling requirements, and electric motor specification.
Applied fluid power engineering principles to design and validate a complete hydraulic system for industrial metal-forming equipment.

title: LabVIEW-Based Simultaneous Control of 3 CNC Stepper Motors
description: Designed and developed a LabVIEW-based motion control system for simultaneous operation of 3 stepper motors used in CNC applications.
Implemented real-time motor speed control by converting user-defined rotational speed inputs into synchronized timing and pulse-delay sequences.
Developed bidirectional motion control functionality with selectable clockwise and counterclockwise rotation modes.
Implemented full-step and half-step drive algorithms to provide configurable motion accuracy and positioning resolution.
Designed step-count and angular-position control modules for precise motor positioning and rotational displacement control.
Generated stepper motor excitation sequences and drive codes required for motor actuation through digital control signals.
Created a graphical Human-Machine Interface (HMI) in LabVIEW for monitoring motor status, operating parameters, and control signals.
Integrated parallel-port (LPT) communication to transmit control commands from a PC to stepper motor driver circuitry.
Implemented automated execution loops, start/stop functionality, and synchronized multi-axis control for coordinated motor operation.

title: Stable Path Planning and Body Angle Analysis of a Biped Robot
description: Analyzed the influence of torso/body angle parameters on the dynamic stability of a biped robot using Zero Moment Point (ZMP) stability criteria.
Developed kinematic and dynamic models of a multi-link biped robot, including body segments, joints, mass distribution, and inertia properties.
Designed stable walking trajectories for single-support gait phases through joint-space path planning and motion constraint formulation.
Generated polynomial-based trajectories for hip, knee, ankle, and foot joints to ensure smooth locomotion and continuous motion profiles.
Performed forward and inverse kinematics calculations to determine joint positions, orientations, and limb trajectories during walking cycles.
Modeled center-of-mass (COM) motion for individual robot segments and the overall system to evaluate balance and gait performance.
Computed segment mass moments of inertia and incorporated dynamic parameters into stability and motion analyses.
Implemented mathematical models, simulations, and trajectory optimization algorithms using Wolfram Mathematica.
Validated walking stability by calculating ZMP trajectories and verifying that support constraints were maintained throughout locomotion.
Conducted sensitivity analysis on torso inclination and posture variations to determine their effects on gait stability and robot balance.
